changelog:
Major update: Skill refocused from personal music organization to text-to-music generation.

- Now generates original music from user prompts, covering full songs, instrumentals, jingles, and covers/restyles of existing tracks.
- Details configuration of advanced music models (MiniMax Music & ACE-Step) for both vocal and instrumental outputs.
- Provides clear instructions for specifying style, genre, lyrics, duration, and other parameters to control music generation.
- Explains workflow: model selection, input requirements, async calls, and polling for results.
- Adds best practices for describing desired music, plus sample references in a new examples file.
- Removes previous documentation for music tracking and playlist organization.
summary: Generate music from a text description - full songs with vocals and lyrics, instrumental beds, jingles, intros, and background tracks. Use when the user says...
